About us
Our StoryTimelineProducts

America's home
on the internet
since 1985.

For 40 years running, millions of Americans have started their day with AOL—checking email, reading the news, staying connected.

30Muse AOL every month
3Mcheck their email with us daily
Top 10email provider worldwide
40+years of keeping people connected

You remember
the sound.

The dial-up screech. The blue welcome screen. “You've Got Mail.” AOL was more than a product: it was the door to a world that didn't exist before. Chat rooms, instant messages, your first email address.

We shipped a billion CDs to get people online. The people who came through that door are still here.

1985

A small online service launches in Virginia for Commodore 64 users. The internet just got its friendliest on-ramp.

1993

AOL mails a billion free trial CDs. You'd find them tucked into cereal boxes, magazines, airplane seat pockets. At one point, half of all CDs produced on Earth are AOL discs.

1997

“You've Got Mail” becomes the most famous phrase online. Half of all US internet users are on AOL. AIM buddy lists change how a generation communicates.

2026

AOL joins Bending Spoons. New ownership, same commitment to the experience you love.

Your inbox has been
with you through
everything.

Job offers, wedding invitations, family updates, vacation plans. Your AOL address is the thread that runs through your digital life. We don't take that lightly.

What we do for you

Everything we build starts with one question: Does this make your day easier?

Headlines, finance, entertainment, sports, weather—curated by real editors, updated around the clock.

Free, fast, and familiar. The inbox 8 million people open every morning.
